name: Sharpen AE
description: Multi scale sharpening like Sapphire S_Sharpen: the picture is split into tiny, small, medium and large detail levels from the Small Detail Size, each level is boosted by its own scale, strong edges are protected by the Edge Threshold so they do not ring, with separate luma, chroma and red / green / blue amounts, a mask from the layer's own luma or alpha with blur and invert, opacity and a detail view.
